name: Privacy policy
heading: Privacy policy.
blurb: What the contact form collects and what happens to it.
body: The quote form currently opens your own mail app rather than posting anywhere, so today the site collects nothing at all. That changes the moment the form is routed through a service, and this page has to exist and be accurate before it does.

name: Terms
heading: Terms of service.
blurb: Deposit, revision rounds, ownership and rush work.
body: The commercial terms are settled and published on the pricing pages — flat price agreed up front, a deposit to begin, revision rounds per package, and named fees for anything beyond them. Turning that into terms of service needs wording written for the business, not a template pasted from another company.
